current_checkpoint_note: Fertiliser Vertical -- End-to-End Real Workflow campaign, baseline 9458ef5 (Farm Awareness / Satellite Field Intelligence campaign closed clean, round 11). Full account: docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_PHASE0.md. Goal: connect FIELD/SOIL STATE -> NUTRIENT REQUIREMENT -> RECOMMENDATION -> PLAN -> GPS JOB -> CONFIRM ACTUAL -> REMAINING REQUIREMENT into one real, demonstrable, end-to-end loop -- not a fertiliser calculator sitting beside the rest of Farm Return. Decisive Phase 0/architecture finding ('no new Plan table'): a canonical planned fertiliser application is a real, accepted/edited fertiliser_recommendation Decision row -- no new persisted entity, no new migration. Lifecycle (Suggested -> Planned -> Active -> Completed-estimated -> Completed-actual -> Dismissed) is derived, never stored, from existing decisions/job_sessions/job_actuals state. New: src/domain/nutrients.ts gained knownFertiliserProductComposition (additive); src/domain/fertiliser-plan.ts (nutrientContributionFromFertiliserActual/sumConfirmedFertiliserApplications/calculateRemainingFertiliserRequirement -- Recommended/Planned/Actual kept distinct per campaign item 4; aggregateFarmFertiliserRecommendation/totalProductQuantityKgByProduct/aggregateFarmFertiliserDemand/toFarmInputDemand -- farm-wide demand, item 19/20); src/orchestration/prompt/fertiliser-recommendation.ts (promptForFertiliserRecommendation, the fifth real Prompt producer now fanned out per field by buildAllRealPrompts; validateFertiliserPlanEdits, a narrow plannedProduct/plannedQuantityKg/plannedDate allowlist -- 'Plan this application'); src/orchestration/fertiliser-plan/index.ts (getFieldRemainingFertiliserRequirement, getFarmFertiliserDemand -- real farm-scoped I/O over the pure domain arithmetic); src/orchestration/job-session/index.ts gained startJobSessionFromPlan (links a job session to an ALREADY-EXISTING accepted plan Decision, never inserting a second Decision -- origin 'plan' on job_sessions existed at the schema level before this campaign but is given real, distinct semantics here for the first time, narrowed apart from startJobSessionFromPrompt's own origin 'prompt'); src/app/actions/fertiliser-plan.ts (getMatchablePlanForFieldAction -- never auto-selects among multiple plans, item 11; startJobSessionFromPlanAction; getLinkedFertiliserPlanForJobSessionAction -- Confirm Actual prefill, item 12; getFieldFertiliserStatusAction -- real remaining requirement, item 14; getFarmFertiliserDemandAction -- item 19/20); src/components/farm/FertiliserPlanSheet.tsx ('Plan this application' UI, Nutrients screen, with a real spreading-window timing disclosure reusing promptForSpreadingWindow, item 7 -- never a new invented suitability score); src/components/farm/RemainingFertiliserRequirementCard.tsx (real remaining-requirement UI, Nutrients screen); GpsActivityCandidateCard.tsx extended to look up a matchable plan before confirming and link to it when unambiguous (item 10); ConfirmActualSheet.tsx extended with an optional linkedPlan prop, prefilling product/quantity exactly once and never overwriting a farmer's own edit; ActiveJobSessionView.tsx wired to fetch the linked plan for a 'plan'-origin session; ai-context/index.ts's FarmContext gained a fertiliserDemand field (item 21) -- real farm-wide totals, no LLM reads it yet. Reuses (unmodified): calculateNutrientPlan, decideAsFarmer, submitPromptDecisionAction's own server-recompute discipline (extended, not replaced, to support fertiliser_recommendation + a validated edits allowlist), createJobSessionFromDecision (private, job-session/index.ts), listConfirmedJobSessionsForFarm, listDecisionsForFarm, listJobSessionDecisionIdsForFarm, computeFarmGrasslandAggregates (extracted from build-all.ts, not duplicated). No migration -- the entire canonical Plan/Actual/remaining-requirement loop is built on existing decisions/job_sessions/job_actuals tables. Deliberately NOT built this campaign (all documented in FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md): supplier marketplace/RFQ/purchasing (item 32), a new inventory subsystem (item 17 -- none real exists to connect), a new profitability engine or unverified fertiliser prices (item 18), silage-branch server-side recommendations (no real persisted SilagePlan exists), a farm-wide demand UI surface beyond the new server action/FarmContext exposure. Quality gate: 1904/1904 tests (145/145 files), up from 1790/1790 (139/139), +114 new tests. Codex audit round 1: 2 Critical + 6 High + 2 Medium found, 9 fixed + 1 rejected (verified not reachable) -- quality gate 1915/1915 (145/145) after fixes. Codex audit round 2: 0 Critical + 3 High + 2 Medium found (all real gaps in round 1's own fixes: farm-wide demand needed the same calendar-year boundary as field-level remaining; a plan already linked to a job session must not also still count as planned; a did_not_happen Actual must be excluded before any counting; FarmContext must not discard the truncated flag; Confirm Actual prefill needed an uncapped single-decision lookup, new getDecisionById) -- all 5 fixed, quality gate 1925/1925 (145/145) after fixes. Codex audit round 3: 0 Critical + 2 High + 0 Medium found (both real gaps in round 2's own fix: excluding an already-linked plan from planned used listJobSessionDecisionIdsForFarm, which also matches a CANCELLED session -- a cancelled job produced no real Actual, so that fix made a genuinely still-outstanding plan vanish from both planned and confirmed permanently; fixed by excluding only via listActiveJobSessionsForFarm/confirmed sessions, never a cancelled one; the truncated flag now also reflects listActiveJobSessionsForFarm's own cap) -- both fixed, quality gate 1928/1928 (145/145) after fixes. A real, pre-existing, disclosed job_sessions schema limitation was found in the process (not introduced by this campaign): the database's own unique(decision_id) constraint means a plan can never be relinked to a second job session, cancelled or not -- documented under FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md's Known limitations, not fixed (outside this campaign's authority over the frozen GPS Job Mode contract). Codex audit round 4: 1 Critical + 2 High + 1 Medium found, all 4 fixed -- CRITICAL: FertiliserPlanSheet's default product/quantity were seeded from NutrientsPageClient's own silage-inclusive plan (mock SilagePlan data), not the real grazing-only figure the server actually validates against, fixed with a separate real grazingOnlyPlan computation; HIGH: a bare-accepted, genuinely multi-product Decision was GPS-matchable as one job, fixed via new isUnambiguouslySingleProductPlan; HIGH: submitPromptDecisionAction's pre-existing, shared lack of retry-idempotency accepted as a disclosed, deliberately narrower fix (a full idempotency-key redesign is cross-cutting/out of scope) with a real in-scope 'already planned' disclosure added instead; MEDIUM: two round-1 fixes gained a real test of their own actual regression case (2026-02-31/leap-year, and a real field-switch remount test). Quality gate 1935/1935 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 5: 1 Critical + 1 High + 1 Medium + 1 Low found, all 4 fixed -- CRITICAL: nutrients.ts's own disclosed mock PRODUCTS prices were propagated by fertiliser-recommendation.ts into a real, persisted Prompt/Decision surface (estimatedFieldCostEur on FertiliserRecommendationSummary, the Prompt description, the Decision's estimateSnapshot) -- fixed by removing it entirely from this vertical's own new surfaces (the pre-existing, frozen PurchasedFertiliserCard display elsewhere on the Nutrients screen is untouched, out of scope); HIGH: computeFarmGrasslandAggregates's own farmGrasslandAreaHa included tillage ground in the LU/ha stocking-rate denominator, a pre-existing bug (predates this campaign) this campaign's function had faithfully reproduced and then widened in blast radius via the new server-side recompute path -- fixed to subtract each field's own real tillage area, and NutrientsPageClient.tsx's separate, identically-buggy inline duplicate removed in favour of calling this one corrected, shared function; MEDIUM: round 4's own 'already planned' disclosure stayed stale immediately after a farmer's own successful save -- fixed with a planRefreshToken counter bumped by onPlanned to force a genuine refetch; LOW: this document's own stale 'quality gate at initial implementation' line (1904/1904) reworded to point to each round's own line instead. Quality gate 1939/1939 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 6: 3 Critical found, all 3 fixed -- two were genuine gaps in round 5's own two CRITICAL fixes, not new regressions: (1) round 5 removed the field-total estimatedFieldCostEur but every entry in FertiliserRecommendationSummary.products still carried its own real costEur (nutrients.ts's own disclosed mock prices), still reaching every persisted Decision's estimateSnapshot and getLinkedFertiliserPlanForJobSessionAction's client response -- fixed with a new, exported sanitiseRecommendedProduct, applied both in the Prompt producer and proactively in NutrientsPageClient.tsx's own separate client-side recommendation prop (built directly from calculateNutrientPlan, a second un-audited path); (2) a tillage field could receive and persist a real, actionable grazing-based recommendation -- this app has no tillage N/P/K table at all -- fixed with a field.plannedUse?.value === 'tillage' gate returning NOT_APPLICABLE('TILLAGE_FIELD_NOT_SUPPORTED') before calculateNutrientPlan is ever called, plus the identical gate added to NutrientsPageClient.tsx's own client-side 'Plan this application' check; (3) an empty, un-evidenced livestockGroups read produced a concrete, actionable 35 kg N/ha recommendation (Table 12-3 has no real '0 LU/ha' row -- nGrazingSucklerToBeefKgHa clamps to its lowest defined 1.0 LU/ha row instead, and this app cannot distinguish 'confirmed zero livestock' from 'never entered') -- fixed with a new BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE('MISSING_LIVESTOCK_DATA') gate, scoped only to the branch that would otherwise become OK so an unrelated NOT_APPLICABLE (Index 4, commonage) is never affected, plus the identical client-side gate. Quality gate 1941/1941 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 7: 3 Critical + 1 High found, all 4 fixed -- three were genuine gaps in round 6's own fixes (a fix applied to the field-level Prompt producer but missing a second, independent code path over the same real data), not new regressions: (1) getFarmFertiliserDemand -- a second, independent farm-wide aggregation -- called calculateNutrientPlan for every field unconditionally, bypassing both of round 6's fail-closed gates entirely (those gates live only inside promptForFertiliserRecommendation), fixed by excluding a tillage field, and every field when the farm has no recorded livestock, from this aggregation too; (2) getLinkedFertiliserPlanForJobSessionAction/getMatchablePlanForFieldAction both forwarded a real, already-persisted Decision's own frozen estimateSnapshot verbatim -- a Decision persisted before round 6's sanitiseRecommendedProduct fix existed can still carry a real per-product mock costEur -- fixed by sanitising defensively at the read boundary regardless of whether the snapshot predates or postdates round 6; (3) a plan persisted before round 6's gates existed remained fully executable -- neither matching nor starting a job re-checked whether the field's current live recommendation still supports it -- fixed with a new isPlanStillCurrentlyRecommendable, applied to both getMatchablePlanForFieldAction and (defense in depth) startJobSessionFromPlanAction; (4) HIGH: the farm-wide 'Planned' total stayed zero for a real, genuinely unambiguous accepted plan -- round 2's own product judgement call was never reconciled with round 4's later isUnambiguouslySingleProductPlan refinement -- fixed by counting a bare-accepted single-product plan's own recommendation toward Planned too. Quality gate 1949/1949 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 8: 2 Critical + 2 High found, all 4 fixed -- two were a third instance of round 7's own class of gap (the same sanitisation/eligibility fix needed applying to a THIRD, independent code path): (1) src/app/(app)/records/page.tsx forwards every real DecisionRecord straight to its client component, unsanitised -- a legacy fertiliser Decision can still carry a real per-product mock costEur -- fixed by moving sanitiseDecisionRecordForClient out of the 'use server' actions file (which cannot export a synchronous function) into fertiliser-plan/index.ts and applying it here too; (2) getFarmFertiliserDemand's own 'Planned' computation never checked whether a Decision's field was currently recommendable -- a third active/executable interpretation path for a legacy tillage/no-livestock plan the matching/starting actions already refuse -- fixed by gating Planned on the same field-eligibility set Recommended already computes; (3) HIGH: startJobSessionFromPromptAction (pre-existing, cross-cutting, not written by this campaign) never validated activityType against promptKind, so a direct caller could authorise an unrelated activity type alongside a real fertiliser recommendation -- fixed with a narrow check scoped to just the one Prompt kind this campaign introduced; (4) HIGH: round 7's own tillage/missing-livestock filter was duplicated inline rather than reusing promptForFertiliserRecommendation's own authoritative rules, recreating the drift mechanism responsible for rounds 6 and 7 -- fixed by exporting isTillageField/hasNoRecordedLivestock as the one real, shared home for both predicates. Quality gate 1958/1958 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 9: 2 Critical + 2 High found; 2 Critical + 1 High fixed, 1 High rejected (documented) -- deliberately asked to hunt for a FOURTH instance of the 'independent code path missing the gate' pattern rounds 6-8 each found once. Found one real, genuinely new fourth instance: src/lib/reports.ts's buildNutrientPlanReportCsv (a pre-existing V1/V3 report generator this campaign had never touched) called calculateNutrientPlan directly for every field with its own duplicated tillage-inclusive farmGrasslandAreaHa computation (the identical bug round 5 fixed elsewhere), labelling a tillage field 'Grazing' and exporting a real grassland N/P/K recommendation to a real signed-in farmer's downloaded CSV, and could export the clamped 35 kg N/ha for an empty herd -- fixed by reusing computeFarmGrasslandAggregates/isTillageField/hasNoRecordedLivestock. The same report also exported nutrients.ts's own disclosed mock costEur/estimatedFieldCostEur -- fixed by removing the 'Estimated cost (EUR)' column entirely. HIGH (fixed): round 8's own eligibility gate checked only the two named tillage/missing-livestock cases, not a full recompute -- a field newly missing soil evidence, at Index 4, or under a new commonage/buffer prohibition still counted toward both Recommended and Planned -- fixed by having getFarmFertiliserDemand call promptForFertiliserRecommendation itself, per field, using its real basis.status === 'OK' as the one authoritative signal. HIGH (rejected, documented): isPlanStillCurrentlyRecommendable checking only basis.status, not whether the stored plan's own specific product/quantity still matches the live recommendation -- conflicts with this campaign's own explicit item-4 design decision that a farmer's Plan is a frozen value deliberately independent of later recommendation drift (validateFertiliserPlanEdits's own doc comment already states a planned quantity may legitimately differ from the recommendation, by design) -- see evidence-register.md and FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md's own round-9 section for the full rejection rationale. Quality gate 1962/1962 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 10: 3 Critical + 2 High found, all 5 fixed; round 9's rejection withdrawn -- deliberately asked to hunt for a FIFTH instance of the 'independent code path missing the gate' pattern rounds 6-9 each found once, and to independently re-assess round 9's own rejected finding rather than defer to it. CRITICAL (fixed): NutrientsPageClient.tsx's own display (requirement/NAP/organic-offset/purchased-product cards) never applied the tillage/missing-livestock gates round 6 only ever applied to the button -- this app's own primary signed-in screen for this exact figure had been showing fabricated agronomy since round 6 -- fixed with an honest disclosure naming the real reason. CRITICAL (fixed): src/domain/finance.ts's calculateFarmFertiliserRequirement/calculateFarmSlurryNutrientValueEur (pre-existing Phase 4/6 domain code, reaching Dashboard/Finance/Input Planner) -- a fifth independent gate-bypass path -- had the identical tillage-inclusive area bug and no tillage/missing-livestock gate at all -- fixed by adding a new additive farmGrasslandAggregates export to nutrients.ts itself (the correct lowest layer) and excluding a tillage field, or a grazing field with no recorded livestock, from both aggregations (a silage field is never excluded for missing livestock); the same functions' own disclosed mock costEur/estimatedFieldCostEur figures are REJECTED as out of scope -- a pre-existing, already-disclosed limitation of this whole-farm surface, the same class this campaign has left alone since round 5 (PurchasedFertiliserCard.tsx). HIGH (fixed): round 9's own CSV eligibility fix left the products cell ambiguous for a genuinely NOT_APPLICABLE field (Index 4, commonage) -- fixed with an explicit NOT_APPLICABLE sentinel, distinct from INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. HIGH (fixed, round 9 rejection withdrawn): Codex's own re-assessment correctly separated 'quantity must match' (no -- round 9's own point, still correct) from 'product must still be among the live recommendation at all' (yes) -- fixed with a new isPlanProductStillRecommended, applied in both getMatchablePlanForFieldAction and startJobSessionFromPlanAction. Quality gate 1976/1976 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 11: 1 Critical + 1 High found, both fixed -- sixth and seventh independent gate-bypass paths, deliberately hunted for after round 10 asked to look for a fifth. CRITICAL (fixed): RecommendationAuditTrailCard.tsx's 'Generate audit trace' -- a sixth independent path, and the first that PERSISTS its output (a real CalculationRun in localStorage, peer-reviewable and exportable as CSV/JSON/text) -- summed every field unconditionally and ran calculateNutrientPlanWithTrace with no tillage/missing-livestock gate -- fixed by reusing farmGrasslandAggregates and skipping ineligible fields before generating a run. HIGH (fixed): real-alerts.ts's deriveRealAlerts -- a seventh independent path -- had the same denominator bug and no gate, but only one of its four alert types (NAP-ceiling) is actually built from the grazing/agronomic ledger; the other three (commonage, water-buffer, soil-test-age) are real, land-use/livestock-independent field properties, deliberately left ungated -- fixed by gating only the NAP-ceiling alert. Round 10's own 5 fixes independently re-verified as correct and complete. Quality gate 1982/1982 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round. Codex audit round 12: 0 Critical + 1 High found, fixed -- asked to hunt for an eighth independent gate-bypass path and independently verify round 11's own claim that the water-buffer alert is entirely field-intrinsic. That claim was half wrong: checkLocalBufferOverride genuinely reads only field.waterBufferContext (field-intrinsic), but nationalBufferDistanceStatus is not -- nutrients.ts's own bufferMaterial selects 'chemical_fertiliser' whenever the grazing/agronomic ledger's allocatedProducts is non-empty, so a tillage field or an un-evidenced empty herd can fabricate that blend and trigger a real 'Water-buffer distance not met' alert checked against the wrong regulatory material. Fixed by gating only the national-buffer half on the same ledgerDependentAlertsEligible check the NAP-ceiling alert already uses (extracted as one shared variable); the local-override half stays ungated. No new independent gate-bypass path found -- the pattern search across every real call site of calculateNutrientPlan/calculateGrasslandStockingRateKgHa/calculateNutrientPlanWithTrace/checkNapCompliance/farmGrasslandAggregates came back with every site already fixed or genuinely exempt. Codex audit round 13: 0 Critical + 3 High + 1 Medium found, all 4 fixed -- asked to verify round 12's fix, do one more exhaustive tillage/missing-livestock sweep, and step back for a genuinely broad review unrelated to that pattern. Round 12 confirmed correct; one further pattern instance remained (the CSV's own NAP columns, the last unclosed instance across 8 consecutive rounds 6-13), and three genuinely different issues surfaced. HIGH (fixed): buildNutrientPlanReportCsv's own 4 NAP compliance columns still read plan.napCompliance directly, ungated, unlike the other columns -- fixed by gating on the same nRecommendable. HIGH (fixed): getFarmFertiliserDemand's Planned total never applied round 10's isPlanProductStillRecommended rule -- fixed by capturing each recommendable field's own real recommendation and checking every planned quantity's product against it. HIGH (fixed): GpsActivityCandidateCard.tsx's Confirm button never waited for its own real matchable-plan lookup to settle -- a quick tap could bypass a real, unambiguous plan link -- fixed with a new matchablePlanLoading state disabling Confirm until the lookup genuinely settles. MEDIUM (fixed): NutrientsPageClient's 'already planned' copy overclaimed 'more than one' for a truncation-caused ambiguous result that could carry a candidateCount of 0 or 1 -- fixed by checking candidateCount >= 2 before making that claim. Quality gate 1990/1990 (146/146) after fixes. contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round.

notes: BUILD_STATE.json is the single machine-readable source of truth scripts/autopilot.sh reads to decide what to do next.
